newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE shares fall in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE shares fall in Beirut.

text.p: SOLIDERE shares fell on Friday on the Beirut Stock exchange (BSE).
A shares fell to $111.25 from $112 on Thursday and B shares also dropped to $115 from $117.
Turnover was 3,994 shares from Thursday's 3,438 and the value of traded shares was $452,108 from $391,077.
There was no trade in the four other listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index fell 0.34 percent to 84.01 and BLOM stock index fell 0.98 percent to 966.10.
